messages:
alice_support: Hey team — customer (org_id=org_abc123, acct: acme-ux) says they clicked a partner promo link, UI showed "Credits applied: $100" and they got the confirmation email, but their Console balance is 0 and API calls return 402. Webhook delivery shows 200 from our partner. Can billing/ingest confirm ledger status?

ingest-bot: Webhook received: event_id=evt_98765, src=partner-webhook, http_status=200, timestamp=1931234566. Payload parsed, enqueued to billing-ingest. Ingest result: queued.

raj_eng: Thanks — can you grab the webhook payload and the last few ledger rows for org_abc123? Also include the promo_token value. Suspect ingestion race or null amount mapping.

alice_support: Payload snippet from partner (redacted):
```
{ "org_id": "org_abc123", "promo_token": "PARTNER-TRIAL-2026", "amount_cents": 10000, "email": "acct@acme.com" }
```
Ledger query I ran returned this (latest 2 rows):
```
id | org_id     | amount_cents | status          | metadata
---+------------+--------------+-----------------+---------------------------
345| org_abc123 | NULL         | ingested_pending| {"promo_token":"PARTNER-TRIAL-2026"}
344| org_abc123 | 0            | applied         | {"source":"promo_test"}
```
So the ingest row is present but amount_cents is NULL.

maria_finance: I see the same. The billing-ingest service sometimes creates a placeholder row while downstream mapping finishes; looks like mapping returned null for amount. We have an in-flight retry but it hasn't populated. I can manual-apply if ops approves.

olivia_ops: Checking ingest logs now. Found an error at 1931234567 in ingest-worker-2: 
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address when reading amount
stack: /app/ingest/mapper.go:87
```
This correlates with a rolling restart around the same time. It appears voucher-service returned amount in a separate async call and the mapper didn't reconcile on worker restart. Filed ENG-4098.

raj_eng: Repro steps for the bug:
1) partner webhook posts event with promo_token and pending flag
2) ingest mapper does async lookup to voucher-service
3) if mapper restarts mid-lookup, it writes a row with NULL amount_cents
4) no alert triggers because rows with status=ingested_pending aren't monitored for NULL amounts
Suggested quick fix: treat NULL amount as 0 in mapping and emit an alert for ingested_pending with amount_cents IS NULL. Patch snippet: 
```
if entry.AmountCents == nil {\n  entry.AmountCents = ptr(0)\n  alert("ingest:missing_amount", entry.ID)\n}
```

alice_support: Customer escalation is high — can we do a manual ledger write now so they can proceed? They are on a trial and need the credit immediately.

maria_finance: I can run a manual apply if ops gives the green light. Command we run internally: `finance-admin ledger_manual_credit --org org_abc123 --amount-cents 10000 --reason "partner promo manual apply"`

olivia_ops: Running manual apply now. Output: 
```
> finance-admin ledger_manual_credit --org org_abc123 --amount-cents 10000 --reason "partner promo manual apply"
Manual credit created: ledger_777, applied_at=1931237860, created_by=olivia_ops
```
Verified in DB: row id 346 | org_abc123 | 10000 | applied | {"manual_by":"olivia_ops","reason":"partner promo manual apply"}

alice_support: Confirmed with customer: balance now shows $100. They were able to generate a token successfully. Sending apology + note that we applied credits manually. :white_check_mark:

raj_eng: Root cause summary for postmortem: ingest mapper can write placeholder rows with NULL amount on restart; no alert for NULL amounts. Action items: ENG-4098 (hotfix to treat NULL as 0 + alert), ENG-4099 (add reconciliation job to pick up NULL amount rows and retry voucher lookup), ops ticket OPS-221 to adjust restart ordering.

maria_finance: Filing reimbursement/ledger audit: I'll mark ledger_777 as manual promo apply and add notes. Finance will keep an eye on partner-settlements.

alice_support: Thanks all — closing this thread. Notified customer and updated ticket with ledger_777. If anyone wants to add follow-up notes, drop them here.
